changelog.zh:
- 新增：手机端播放页面横竖屏切换悬浮按钮
- 优化：悬浮按钮跟随控制栏显示/隐藏
- 优化：退出播放页面自动恢复原屏幕方向设置
- 优化：悬浮按钮位置调整,避免遮挡底部控制按钮
- 新增：全平台首次启动免责声明功能
- 新增：全平台自定义User-Agent支持
- 新增：10个预设User-Agent选项
- 新增：TV端扫码输入User-Agent功能
- 新增：播放器右上角显示User-Agent开关
- 优化：TV端设置界面避免焦点陷阱
- 修复：重置设置时正确还原User-Agent
- 修复：Android原生播放器User-Agent硬编码问题
changelog.en:
- New: Screen orientation toggle floating button on mobile player page
- Optimization: Floating button follows control bar visibility
- Optimization: Auto restore screen orientation when exiting player
- Optimization: Adjusted floating button position to avoid blocking bottom controls
- New: First-launch disclaimer for all platforms
- New: Custom User-Agent support for all platforms
- New: 10 preset User-Agent options
- New: QR code input for User-Agent on TV
- New: Display User-Agent in player top-right corner
- Optimization: TV settings UI avoids focus trap
- Fix: Correctly restore User-Agent when resetting settings
- Fix: Android native player User-Agent hardcoded issue
